ex.en: She got all dolled up for her big date.
ex.zh: 為了這次重要的約會，她精心打扮了一番。

ex.en: They went on their first date last Friday.
ex.zh: 他們上週五第一次約會。

ex.en: Who told you that Tom and I are dating?
ex.zh: 誰告訴你我和湯姆在交往的？

ex.en: Dan dated Linda when she was a teenager.
ex.zh: 丹在琳達十幾歲時跟她交往過。

ex.en: Would you ever consider dating your best friend's ex-boyfriend?
ex.zh: 你會考慮跟好朋友的前男友交往嗎？

ex.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
No one can have three different birth dates.
ex.zh: 沒有人會有三個不同的生日。

ex.en: My car was badly damaged in the accident.
ex.zh: 我的車在車禍中嚴重損壞。

ex.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.
ex.zh: 這台電器一定是在運送途中損壞的。

ex.en: Last week's storm damaged many trees in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 上週的暴風雨吹壞了我們社區很多樹。
